comment: default preserves immediate aimbody behavior; smooth treats camera look as a wish direction and smoothly moves the body and configured limbs toward it. World Z is vertical and body yaw rotates around world Z. smoothingFactor 1.0 is approximately a 250 ms response; larger values are slower and smaller values are faster. Smooth mode never snaps. For each limb, gains scale camera look pitch into local pitch/yaw/roll rotations. Camera sway is configured separately in camconfig.json.
